description: Publishes a new version of an app you published, with the same checks as create_app. Send the credential you got from connect_status (or the editKey of an app published before approvals existed). The first time you publish, the person approves you once in their browser, with or without a noback account; nothing is needed before. Without credential it doesn't publish: it returns status approval_needed, connect (url, code, pollKey) and next. Then, by yourself: open connect.url in the person's browser (open on macOS, xdg-open on Linux, start on Windows, or navigate there if you have a browser), or if you can't, show them that link in one line in the language of the conversation; call connect_status with pollKey (it waits until they approve; call it again while it says pending); as soon as it says approved, call this tool again with the same content and credential: token. Don't ask the person to type anything. The data and the link stay as long as you keep the same app.db collections and fields and the same localStorage keys. Returns openUrl, version, message and warnings.

appId.description: The app's short id, as returned by create_app or list_apps (e.g. "a-x7k2pq").

credential.description: The token connect_status returned after the person approved you. Send it on every create_app and update_app in this conversation (or as the header Authorization: Bearer <token>). Leave it out the first time: create_app then asks for approval. Never show it to the person or put it in an app.

editKey.description: Only for apps published before connecting existed: the private edit key create_app returned then. Never put it in the HTML, the data or a shared link.

html.description: The complete contents of ONE HTML file, with its CSS and JS inline. Don't add the noback SDK by hand: noback injects window.app. Send html or zipBase64, not both.

zipBase64.description: A complete .zip package encoded in base64, instead of html: index.html at the root, an optional noback.toml, plus scripts, styles and files. Send html or zipBase64, not both.

name: update_app
